c.v: Each register has the same layout: STATE in bits [1:0], WR_ADDR in bits [8:2], RD_ADDR in bits [15:9] (all RO).
The IN endpoint registers (33.13 to 33.16) reset STATE to 0x1 and the other fields to 0x0; the OUT endpoint registers (33.17 to 33.19) reset all fields to 0x0.
Register 33.18 additionally has REC_DATA_CNT in bits [22:16].
